titleBack: Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers

flipToBack.timing: OPTIONAL top-level action by owner (player chooses when); enabled after a required after-trigger tracker clears while-in-play data. NOT an automatic isTableChanged flip.
flipToBack.prose: Owner may flip any time once the deployed-system tracker is satisfied: the 'Hidden Base' indicator system has been deployed AND (6+ tracked system titles exist, i.e. hidden base non-battleground + 5 battlegrounds, OR the hidden base system is itself a battleground and 5+ tracked titles exist). Tracker counts titles of systems the owner justDeployed that are battleground systems or the hidden-base title; when threshold met, setWhileInPlayData(null), which enables the top-level Flip action.

children.req: chosen-state/counter: while-in-play data cleared by deployed-system tracker
tracker input: owner just deployed a system (battleground or hidden-base title recorded)
children.filter: Filters.system; classified via Filters.battleground_system.accepts(...) or title == stacked hidden-base title

children.req: tracker threshold: hidden base deployed AND (size>=6 OR (hiddenBaseIsBattleground AND size>=5)) -> setWhileInPlayData(null)
children.gameConditions: (inline tracker logic, not a GameConditions call)

flipToFront.timing: NEVER flips back. Back has a hard-lose instead: placed OUT OF PLAY when the 'Hidden Base' system is 'probed'.
flipToFront.prose: No FlipCardEffect exists on the back. Required after-trigger: when TriggerConditions.systemProbed fires and the probed system's title equals the stacked hidden-base indicator's title, the objective is placed out of play, indicator removed, probe cards go to opponent's Used Pile, and opponent may retrieve 1 Force per Probe Droid used to probe.

requirementSemantics: flipToBack: pure deployment-count tracker (chosen-state stored in WhileInPlayData string->boolean map keyed by system title); no control/occupy check at flip time
flipToBack: flip is OPTIONAL (TopLevelGameTextAction), owner decides timing; 'any time after' per card text

hard-lose (back): event trigger systemProbed matching stacked indicator title; opponent creates probes at systems opponent OCCUPIES (Filters.occupies(opponentAsActionOwner)) during any deploy phase, one card from hand under a system not already probed
back drain-cancel: limit per turn = min(2, count of battleground systems CONTROLLED by owner (Filters.controls(playerId)))
typedIdentities: Filters.and(Filters.planet_system, Filters.planetSystemInParsecRange(1, 8)) (hidden-base indicator stacked from outside deck)
